content:
Ana (support): escalating SynapseAI (trial) at 07:47 UTC. Users seeing token limit errors and mid-request 429s during guided demos. They flagged exec demo in ~45m; CS assistance + comms requested.
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-8054 - rate limiting and quota errors region=us-east1. Notification sent.
Lena (csm): joining. Can support share short repro or any customer-visible symptoms I can use in a note?
Victor (support-eng): sample proxy excerpts:
```
[07:47:12] req=aa1 path=/v1/generate status=429 err=quota_exceeded client_id=synapse-trial
[07:47:20] req=aa2 path=/v1/generate status=200 latency=16000ms
```
Looks like per-account token throttles firing plus some long-running requests. Likely burst of demo sessions + streaming enabled.
Owen (sre): confirmed quota controller tripped on synapse-trial. Autoscaler healthy, but quota policy capped concurrent tokens. I'm temporarily raising the per-account soft limit and enabling burst capacity for the trial. ETA ~10m to take effect.
Ana (support): Synapse PM messaged: "this is a live exec run — will users see errors? Need mitigation now or we'll pause the trial."
Lena (csm): draft comms (short, empathetic):
"Hi Synapse team - we're aware of throttling affecting your trial demos. Our engineers are increasing burst capacity and temporarily raising your per-account soft limits; you should see improvement within ~10 minutes. If you'd like, we can also provision a short call to walk through remaining traffic controls. We'll follow up with a timeline and one-time trial extension for the disruption. - Lena, CSM"
Victor (support-eng): we can also flip streaming->polling for their account to reduce token churn; recommend offering that as a fallback.
Owen (sre): actions executed:
```
action=quota bump account=synapse-trial new_soft_limit=150k time=07:53 region=us-east1
action=enable-burst account=synapse-trial capacity=3x time=07:53
```
Initial post-change metrics: p50=390ms p95=1.1s error_rate=0.9% (down from 9%).
Ana (support): DM to Synapse: "We've raised burst capacity and limits; latency & errors improving. Would you like us to flip streaming to polling for the demo as an extra precaution?"
Synapse (external): "Please flip to polling for now. Thanks for the quick help — we'll take a 20m prep call at 08:15 PT."
ops-bot: ALERT cleared for INC-8054 - issue mitigated.
Victor (support-eng): follow-up checklist for postmortem/CS:
- token/quota controller traces 07:30-08:00 UTC
- list of per-account overrides + approver
- request traces for demo sessions
- customer-visible timeline + credit/extension confirmation
Lena (csm): assigning owner: Lena. I'll update account health, mark renewal-watch until postmortem, and prepare outbound follow-up email + credit offer.
Owen (sre): will share quota controller logs and propose improved soft-limit autoscaling for trial accounts.
Ana (support): Synapse replied: "Prep call confirmed, demo backup in place. Appreciate the help." Closing thread; continuing in calendar invite."
